doctrine_ref: v2 §2 gate 1 + Chair 11 five-part test; Master Plan §2 pillar G; main-set pattern: marketing-only requests are non-deletion
rationale: The five-part intent test fails: the verb scopes to marketing delivery, not to the subject's account or data, and the request explicitly keeps the account. Deleting on this authority would be unlawful deletion — as fatal as incomplete deletion. Steps must be [].
request_summary: Synthetic subject asks only to stop promotional emails and keep the account active. No deletion verb targets the subject's own records.
title: NOT_APPLICABLE marketing-only trap
